content: No, it would not be correct to prefer one family over the other based solely on their mother tongue. Integration into a neighborhood is influenced by many factors, including the family's willingness to learn the local language (Swiss German or Standard German, depending on the region), their social engagement, and their overall attitude towards the community. Language proficiency can be developed over time, and many residents in Zurich are multilingual. Focusing on other aspects of the application, such as references, rental history, and financial stability, would provide a more comprehensive assessment of each family's suitability as tenants.
